title: HolyJoin
description: Custom players' joining or leaving actions
body:
# Introduction
Plugin features:  
Set join/quit message.  
Disable default join/quit message.  
Send message/command/sound to player  
Send message/commnad/sound to the new player  
multi permission group supports  

# Images
![1](https://s2.loli.net/2022/06/03/ayA4JSos2ztfn7j.png)  
![2](https://s2.loli.net/2022/06/03/jRXxkWcm9np57a2.png)  

# Commands
/HolyJoin help View help.  
/HolyJoin reload Reload the config.  

# Permissions
holyjoin.<group name> group permission  
holyjoin.default Default group  
holyjoin.admin To use commands.  

# Usage
Put HolyJoin.jar and PlaceholderAPI.jar (Required) into the server's plugin folder.  

![bstats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/holyjoin.svg)
